name: cftc-cot-tracker
title: CFTC Commitments of Traders (COT) Tracker
description: Weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders positioning for every US futures market: how commercials, large speculators, managed money, and leveraged funds are long/short in FX, gold, crude, indices, and crypto futures, with net position and week-over-week change. Legacy, disaggregated, and TFF reports.
